subject: Mythology
title: Ganesha: The Elephant-Headed God
description: A quick, practical guide to Ganesha: The Elephant-Headed God.

hook.text: Ganesha is worshipped before every new beginning because he removes obstacles from your path.

buildup.text: Parvati created him from clay to guard her door. When Shiva returned, Ganesha refused to let him pass.

discovery.text: Furious, Shiva cut off the boy's head before realizing he had just killed his own wife's beloved son.

twist.text: To fix his mistake, Shiva replaced the head with the first animal he found — an elephant.

climax.text: Ganesha became the most popular god in Hinduism, invoked at weddings, exams, and every new venture.

punchline.text: A terrible mistake created the most beloved god in India.

quiz.question: How did Ganesha get his elephant head?
options: He was born with it as a sign of divine wisdom
Shiva replaced his head with an elephant's after cutting it off
A curse from a demon transformed his appearance
